payload.blocks: Phase 7 and the done status of plan 261124-0004-heads-operate-without-owner; phases 1, 2, 3 and 6 are on main.
payload.headline: Build and activate a release with e36f10cf, and run the full suites unconfined, to finish heads plan phase 7

parts.cause: The fix is in the host binary, so it is proven only on a release that contains it; release run cannot ship itself yet (the gap, and no release recipe in .fgos/config.yaml). npm test and cargo test --workspace cannot run inside the lead's sandbox.

options.cost: About 30 minutes of owner time including the suites.
options.does: Owner builds and activates a release at or after e36f10cf, runs npm test and cargo test --workspace on main, and answers here; then the supervisor restarts the probe heads and the lead re-runs the probe and release run.
options.gain: Phase 7 closes against the real release, with the full DoD suites.
options.harm: One more manual activation (PC-D9 already made the first one manual).
options.label: You build, activate and run the suites

options.does: Mark phase 7 done with the gaps recorded as fixed but unproven live; the re-probe becomes a backlog row.
options.harm: Acceptance criterion 3 (no failed row) is not met; release run stays unproven.
options.label: Close on the 3beba73a probe

parts.recommendation: You build, activate and run the suites: the gaps sit in the host binary, so only a release that contains the fix can prove acceptance criterion 3.

scope.allows: Finishing phase 7 of this plan: a release at or after e36f10cf, the two full suites, the re-probe and one release run.
scope.forbids: Writing the release recipe into .fgos/config.yaml (the owner's separate config patch, q-dhhezn67em) and any change outside this plan.

parts.what: The live probe on release 3beba73a found three window gaps in all five personas: release run is unreachable (no command route), every verb a head types in its shell is refused because of the shell function's --dir, and refused forwarded verbs lose their code. The fix landed as e36f10cf (reviewed, routing and forwarder tests green). Tables: plans/261124-0004-heads-operate-without-owner/reports/head-grant-probe.md.
